title: The continuous module encoding preserves and reflects finite local freeness
statement: Let X be any scheme, T a totally disconnected commutative topological ring, and P an internal module over the condensed continuous T coefficient ring. For the encoding of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], the encoded module sheaf is finite locally free if and only if there exists a pro-etale scheme cover of X on each of whose members raw internal inverse image of P is finite free. The cover has the original scheme universe and no finiteness or nonemptiness restriction. This criterion gives finite local freeness for the rational encoding of a locally free P and a raw-inverse-image free scheme cover for the inverse integral encoding of any given finite locally free integral module.

source.place: Tags 03DM and 03DO (finite locally free modules and localization); Bhatt--Scholze, Section 6.8

proof.text: A scheme pro-etale cover gives a covering family on the small pro-etale site by evaluating at its terminal object. Apply the slice finite-freeness criterion, lift the indexing family to the site-object universe, and use the Mathlib local-generators criterion isFiniteLocallyFree_of_exists_over_iso_free. Ranks may vary with the member.

Conversely use finite locally free local-generators data. Each finite generating set yields a finite free presentation. Its covering sieve at the terminal object contains a pro-etale precover. Refine along its arrows and pull back the free presentations using overFunctorMap, overMapUnitIso, and mapFreeIso. The smallness of the pro-etale precoverage restricts its indexing set to the original scheme universe. Apply the slice criterion to obtain the required raw-inverse-image free cover.

For the rational coefficient normalization use finiteLocallyFree_restrict after lisseFieldSheaf_eq. For the inverse integral encoding first use the inverse coefficient isomorphism, then the encoding counit, then the reverse direction of the continuous-ring criterion.

theorem continuousRing_locallyFree_iff
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (T : Type)
    [CommRing T] [TopologicalSpace T] [IsTopologicalRing T] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace T]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj T) X)) :
    (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj T) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) ↔
      ((continuousRingModuleEquivalence X T).functor.obj P).IsFiniteLocallyFree
